tagline: The Twin Cities' Jammin'-est 90's Rock Tribute!
fullBio: The Nine Teas (T.N.T.) is the Twin Cities’ premier power trio delivering high-energy 90s alternative rock, grunge, and pop-punk anthems. From raucous full-electric festival sets to intimate 'T.N.T. Unplugged' acoustic shows, we'll bring the final decade of last millenuim's biggest hits and crowd sing-alongs to stages across Minnesota & Wisconsin.
notableHighlights: Always on time and ready to rock
Stage veteran leadership & accountability, but with the fun & excitement of a fresh act
We'll play the hits and those deep cut nostalgia blasts
Moments of improv musicianship punctuate a show that is more than just boring rote covers
Able to provide sound and/or lights for smaller/medium venues

stagePlotNotes: 3-piece power trio requires 3 monitor mixes, 1 drum vocal, 1 center guitar vocal, and 1 bass vocal. XLR for guitar signal (2 if stereo), DI box for Bass, mics for 4 piece drumkit with plenty of cymbals.
